
playbook: playbooks/provision.yml

  play #1 (stack): Provision the server	TAGS: []
    tasks:
      Keep the clock synchronized, which the certificates and tokens below rely on	TAGS: []
      Authorize the SSH key of the project	TAGS: []
      Take the WireGuard keys of the devices	TAGS: []
      Configure the WireGuard interface	TAGS: []
      Deny incoming except SSH, WireGuard and the declared ports	TAGS: []
      Unpack the backup to restore from	TAGS: []
      Check whether Consul is installed yet	TAGS: []
      Run the Consul agent	TAGS: []
      Restore Consul from the backup	TAGS: []
      Mark Consul as restored, so that a second run does not restore it again	TAGS: []
      Ensure the policy the Nomad agent registers with	TAGS: []
      Ensure the Nomad agent's Consul token	TAGS: []
      Ensure the policy Alloy discovers services with	TAGS: []
      Ensure Alloy's Consul token	TAGS: []
      Ensure the policy Vault registers itself with	TAGS: []
      Ensure Vault's Consul token	TAGS: []
      Resolve Consul names on the host and for the tunnel	TAGS: []
      Issue Consul's gRPC certificate, with DNS names only	TAGS: []
      Consul serves gRPC with it	TAGS: []
      Restart Consul	TAGS: []
      Consul answers again	TAGS: []
      Run Vault	TAGS: []
      Run Docker for the Nomad client	TAGS: []
      The Nomad configuration directory exists	TAGS: []
      The registry auth file is in place	TAGS: []
      Run the Nomad agent	TAGS: []
      Apply a changed registry login to the running Nomad agent	TAGS: []
      unzip is installed	TAGS: []
      The consul-cni release directory exists	TAGS: []
      consul-cni is downloaded, verified against the published checksum	TAGS: []
      consul-cni is unpacked into its release directory	TAGS: []
      consul-cni is in the plugin path Nomad reads	TAGS: []
      Let Nomad see a newly linked consul-cni	TAGS: []
      Ship host and app metrics and logs to the observability backends	TAGS: []
      Read the Vault policy the backup takes snapshots with	TAGS: []
      Ensure the Vault policy allows the snapshot and nothing else	TAGS: []
      Look up the Vault token of the backup	TAGS: []
      Create the Vault token of the backup, renewed by every run	TAGS: []
      Install the hook that copies the host volumes, stopping the jobs that ask for it	TAGS: []
      Back up the copies of the host volumes and the snapshots of Consul, Nomad and Vault	TAGS: []
